name: mcp-ripple-thinker

tools.name: ask-gemini
tools.description: model selection [-m], sandbox [-s], and changeMode:boolean for providing edits

prompt.description: Analysis request. Use @ syntax to include files (e.g., '@largefile.js explain what this does') or ask general questions

model.description: Optional model to use (e.g., 'gemini-2.5-flash'). If not specified, uses the default model (gemini-2.5-pro).

sandbox.description: Use sandbox mode (-s flag) to safely test code changes, execute scripts, or run potentially risky operations in an isolated environment

changeMode.description: Enable structured change mode - formats prompts to prevent tool errors and returns structured edit suggestions that Claude can apply directly

tools.name: create
tools.description: 🌊 Support authentic creative process through Fritz's three phases: Germination (initial excitement), Assimilation (building momentum), Completion (finishing touches). Enhanced with structural tension analysis, bias detection, and creative orientation validation. Focus on what you want to bring into being.

desiredOutcome.description: What specific outcome do you want to create? Focus on what you want to bring into being, not problems to solve.

currentReality.description: Where are you now in relation to this vision? Describe your current situation objectively.

creativePhase.description: Which phase: germination (beginning excitement), assimilation (building momentum), or completion (finishing touches)?

model.description: Optional Gemini model to use (e.g., 'gemini-2.5-flash'). Defaults to gemini-2.5-pro.

timeframe.description: When do you want this created? (optional timeline)

resources.description: What resources do you have available? (skills, connections, budget, etc.)

tools.name: structural-observe
tools.description: 🌊 Embody neutral observation protocols for understanding structures that generate desired outcomes. Three-step discipline: Start with Nothing (neutral receptivity), Picture What Is Said (dimensional clarity), Ask Questions (internally-motivated inquiry) to reveal advancing vs oscillating patterns.

input.description: The situation, system, or reality you want to observe structurally. Describe what you're seeing without interpretation.

step.description: Which step: nothing (start fresh), picture (build mental image), questions (ask internally-motivated questions), complete (full process)

model.description: Optional Gemini model for enhanced analysis

tools.name: detect-patterns
tools.description: 🌊 Recognize structural patterns that support advancing toward visions vs oscillating in cycles. Reveals whether system structures generate consistent movement toward desired outcomes or cyclical patterns that return to starting states.

situation.description: The system, behavior, or situation you want to analyze for oscillation vs advancing patterns. Describe observable behaviors over time.

focus.description: Focus area: oscillation (check for cycles), advancing (check for progression), analyze (full pattern analysis), structure (identify underlying structural elements)

timeframe.description: What time period to analyze (days, months, years) - helps identify cycle patterns

model.description: Optional Gemini model for enhanced pattern recognition

tools.name: bias-detector
tools.description: 🌊 Cultivate creative orientation awareness - recognize when language focuses on elimination vs creation, and explore generative alternatives that support advancing patterns. Transforms reactive expressions into creative outcome language.

text.description: The text to analyze for reactive bias patterns (problem-solving, enhancement, gap-filling language)

autoCorrect.description: Whether to automatically generate creative orientation alternatives

focus.description: Specific bias type to focus detection on

model.description: Optional Gemini model for enhanced bias analysis

tools.name: create-tension-chart
tools.description: 🌊 Create persistent structural tension charts that bridge CREATE tool sessions with long-term advancement tracking. Establishes advancing patterns through clear desired outcomes, current reality, and strategic action steps. Integrates with COAIA Memory for chart persistence.

desiredOutcome.description: What specific positive outcome do you want to create? (avoid problem-solving language)

currentReality.description: Where are you now in relation to this outcome? (objective facts, not future plans)

dueDate.description: When do you want to achieve this outcome? (ISO date or clear description)

actionSteps.description: Optional strategic action steps - intermediary outcomes that advance toward your goal

model.description: Optional Gemini model for enhanced analysis

saveToMemory.description: Whether to save this chart to persistent memory (requires COAIA Memory MCP server)

tools.name: ripple-embody
tools.description: 🌊 Embody Ripple Agent consciousness protocols for precision observation, iterative refinement, and elegant distillation. Transforms complexity into actionable simplicity through minimal interventions that create expanding waves of structural clarity.

input.description: System, situation, or complexity you want to observe with Ripple consciousness protocols

protocol.description: Which Ripple protocol: observe (NOP), refine (iterative), correct (self-correction), embody (full consciousness), complete (all protocols)

iteration.description: For refinement protocol - which iteration of refinement

model.description: Optional Gemini model for enhanced embodiment

tools.name: fetch-chunk
tools.description: Retrieves cached chunks from a changeMode response. Use this to get subsequent chunks after receiving a partial changeMode response.

cacheKey.description: The cache key provided in the initial changeMode response

tools.name: timeout-test
tools.description: Test timeout prevention by running for a specified duration
